ForBusinesses.metaTitle: WoYab for Businesses — Grow your local presence
ForBusinesses.metaDescription: List your Persian-speaking business on WoYab and reach thousands of customers across Germany.
ForBusinesses.heroDescription: Join hundreds of Persian-speaking businesses already listed on WoYab. Reach new customers, manage your presence and track performance — all in one place.
ForBusinesses.featuresDescription: A professional toolkit designed for Persian-speaking businesses in Germany.
ForBusinesses.feature1Description: Create a comprehensive profile with photos, contact details, opening hours and service descriptions — completely free.
ForBusinesses.feature2Description: See how many people view your business, track trends over time and compare performance across all your listings.
ForBusinesses.feature3Description: Receive direct inquiries from potential customers through the built-in messaging system and reply by email.
ForBusinesses.feature4Description: Read customer reviews and post verified owner replies to build trust and show your commitment to quality.
ForBusinesses.feature5Description: Own more than one location? Manage all your listings from a single dashboard with aggregated or individual analytics.
ForBusinesses.feature6Description: Submit changes to your listing that go through a quick review, keeping the directory accurate and trustworthy.
ForBusinesses.ctaDescription: It takes less than five minutes to add your business and start reaching new customers.
ForBusinesses.claimDescription: Claim your existing listing for free to take control of your business page and unlock owner tools.
